name: Kirishima Maika
source:
A girl in the same class as the protagonist.
She is popular with the boys because of her looks, but she has a terrible personality and often says and does things to mislead them.

She has a history of misleading the protagonist into confessing to her, only to then reject him. She is the one who invented the "confession game" to pass the time.

[translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ418575.html/]DLSite[/url]]
